problem: At the bowling alley's birthday event, 32 guests arrive, and the manager assigns 4 guests to every lane. How many lanes do the guests use?
follow_up_questions: The alley has 10 lanes in total. How many lanes stay open for other bowlers?

problem: How many tables will the library reading club need if 32 readers come and each table seats 4 of them?
follow_up_questions: The reading room holds 10 tables. How many of them remain empty?

problem: This autumn, 52 kids have registered for pottery at the community art studio. A pottery group can hold at most 9 kids. How many groups does the studio need to form?
follow_up_questions: Every group needs its own instructor, and the studio employs 4 instructors. How many more instructors must be found?
Each group meets 3 times a week. How many group meetings take place in a week?
A meeting runs for 45 minutes. In total, how many minutes of pottery happen each week?

problem: No chess class at the town hall may have more than 9 players. If 52 players sign up for the winter season, how many classes must the hall organise?
follow_up_questions: There are 4 coaches available, and every class needs a coach. How many coaches still have to be hired?
Classes are held 3 times a week. What is the total number of class meetings per week?
Each of those meetings is 45 minutes long. Find the total minutes of chess lessons in a week.

problem: The bakery opens at 7 every Monday. Earlier that morning, Ms. Petrova arranges 96 bread rolls on trays, 12 to a tray. How many trays does she fill?
How many boxes can a librarian fill if she packs 96 old magazines with 12 in every box? She starts packing at 7, before the library doors open.
Amara wants to read 75 pages of her book this week. She reads 15 pages every evening. How many evenings will she need to finish?
follow_up_questions: Each page has 25 lines. How many lines does she read each evening?

problem: How many days will Tomasz need to run 75 laps around the school yard if he runs 15 laps a day?
follow_up_questions: One lap of the yard is 25 metres. How far does he run each day, in metres?

problem: At the school fair, 41 pupils want a go on the bouncy castle. Only 6 pupils can bounce at once. How many turns are needed so that every pupil gets a go?
follow_up_questions: Every turn on the castle lasts 5 minutes. How many minutes do all the turns take?
Before the bouncing starts, the fair opens with a 15-minute show. How many minutes after the fair opens does the last turn end?

problem: How many trips must the canal boat make? Its captain can take 6 passengers on each trip, and 41 tourists are waiting at the dock to ride it.
follow_up_questions: One trip takes 5 minutes. What is the total time for all the trips, in minutes?
The tourists first watched a 15-minute safety talk. How many minutes after the talk began did the last trip finish?

problem: The craft shop sells crayons in packs of 5. On Monday the owner counts 28 loose crayons. The shop has 25 shelves. How many crayons are left over after she makes as many packs as she can?
follow_up_questions: Under the counter she finds 4 more crayons and puts them with the leftover ones. How many leftover crayons are there now?
She makes one more pack from those. How many crayons are still left over?

problem: After filling as many egg boxes as she can, how many eggs does Farmer Gita have left? Each box takes 5 eggs, her hens laid 28 eggs this morning, and her farm has 25 hens.
follow_up_questions: In the barn she finds 4 more eggs and puts them with the leftovers. How many leftover eggs does she have now?
She fills one more box from them. How many eggs remain outside a box?

problem: Every Friday a music teacher runs a drum circle for little ones. She has 21 shakers and hands 3 to each child. How many children get shakers?
follow_up_questions: The next Friday, 2 of those children are sick. How many shakers does the teacher give out?

problem: How many campers can the camp cook feed if every camper gets 3 pancakes and she made 21 for breakfast?
follow_up_questions: The following morning, 2 of those campers sleep late and skip breakfast. How many pancakes does the cook serve?

problem: The library opens at 6 in the evening on Thursdays. Before then, Diego has 46 minutes to practise piano, and each of his songs takes 4 minutes to play. If he plays only whole songs, how many minutes are left over?
follow_up_questions: He spends those spare minutes and 8 more packing his bag. How long does packing take, in minutes?
Tomorrow he will play 3 fewer songs. How many songs is that?

problem: How many minutes will Ayesha have left over? She has 46 minutes before dinner, which is at 6, and she bakes batches of biscuits that each take 4 minutes, finishing only whole batches.
follow_up_questions: She uses the extra minutes plus 8 more to clean up. How many minutes does cleaning up take?
Tomorrow she plans 3 fewer batches. How many batches will she bake tomorrow?

problem: Mr. Bello explains that the science lab has room for only 4 pupils at the microscope at once. His class has 28 pupils. How many turns at the microscope does the class need?
follow_up_questions: A turn at the microscope lasts 3 minutes. How many minutes does the whole class spend there?

problem: What is the number of lift rides needed to bring 28 dancers up to the stage when the lift takes just 4 at a time?
follow_up_questions: Each ride up takes 3 minutes. How long is it until every dancer is on stage?

problem: Bianca is arranging 75 postcards in the museum shop, 8 in each slot of the stand. She notices the last slot won't be full. How many postcards end up in that last slot?
follow_up_questions: Her boss tells her to move the postcards from that slot into a box, along with 6 more from the back room. How many postcards are in the box?
By Sunday, every postcard in the full slots has sold. How many postcards were sold from the slots?

problem: How many marbles will be in the last bag, the one that won't be full? Theo has 75 marbles and puts 8 into each bag at the toy fair.
follow_up_questions: He tips that bag's marbles into a jar, together with 6 more from his pocket. How many marbles are in the jar?
At the end of the fair, all the full bags have been sold. How many marbles were sold in those bags?

problem: 'Each shelf holds 3 helmets,' the ice rink attendant tells a hockey team, showing them a wall with 40 shelves. The team has 20 helmets. What is the least number of shelves the team can use?
What is the smallest number of baskets the animal shelter needs for its 20 kittens, if each basket holds 3? There are 40 baskets in the storeroom.
Mr. Varga is planning a choir trip for 96 singers. Each coach has 32 seats. How many coaches should he reserve?
follow_up_questions: Renting one coach for the day costs 85 dollars. What is the total cost of the coaches?

problem: With 32 seats on each boat, how many boats must the harbour company send for a group of 96 tourists?
follow_up_questions: The company charges 85 dollars per boat. How much will the group pay for all of them?

problem: A librarian is shelving 50 new comics on a display rack that takes 6 per row. Outside, it has started to rain. How many comics will be in the row that isn't full?
follow_up_questions: By closing time, readers have borrowed every comic in 3 of the full rows. How many comics have been borrowed?
How many comics are still on the rack?
The next morning the librarian adds 4 more full rows. How many comics are on the rack then?

problem: In the row that isn't full, how many jars of honey will there be? A beekeeper is arranging 50 jars on her market stall in rows of 6. Her dog naps under the table.
follow_up_questions: By noon, shoppers have bought all the jars in 3 of the full rows. How many jars have been sold?
How many jars are left on the stall?
After lunch she sets out 4 more full rows. How many jars are on the stall now?

problem: The garden centre's trolleys each carry 4 bags of soil. 'We bought 31 bags!' Auntie Femi says. How many trolleys does she need?
follow_up_questions: Each trolley needs a 2-dollar coin to unlock. How much does she spend on trolleys?
She pays with a 20-dollar note. How much change does she get back?

problem: How many rafts must a scout group hire if each raft takes 4 scouts and there are 31 scouts going down the river?
follow_up_questions: Hiring a raft costs 2 dollars. How much does the group pay for rafts?
The leader hands over a 20-dollar note. What change should she receive?

problem: At the school picnic, Mr. Dube has 36 sandwiches and asks Leila to put 6 on each tray. Find the number of trays Leila fills.
follow_up_questions: Four trays are finished before the races begin. How many trays of sandwiches remain?

problem: How many bowls will Ravi fill? Grandma has picked 36 strawberries and wants 6 in every bowl for the guests.
follow_up_questions: The guests empty 4 bowls straight away. How many bowls of strawberries are still full?

problem: Ms. Novak has 58 photos to put in an album she bought 12 years ago. 'I'll fit 9 on each page,' she says. When all the full pages are done, how many photos will be left?
How many buttons will be left once Mrs. Achebe sews as many full rows of 9 as she can? She is decorating a coat with 12 pockets and has 58 buttons.
Chloe collected 45 seashells on the beach. 'One bucket holds 8 shells,' her uncle says. How many buckets does Chloe need to take them all home?
follow_up_questions: She gives 2 of the buckets to her cousins. How many buckets does she keep?
The beach shop charged 5 dollars for each bucket Chloe used. How much did she pay?

problem: How many boxes must the librarian use to pack 45 donated books if each box holds 8 books?
follow_up_questions: She sends 2 boxes to the school next door. How many boxes stay at the library?
Every box she used cost 5 dollars. What did all the boxes cost?

problem: The ski lodge has rooms that sleep 4 skiers each, and 64 skiers have booked for the weekend. Work out how many rooms the lodge must prepare.
follow_up_questions: Each room gets 8 towels. How many towels should the lodge get ready?

problem: How many rowing boats must the club put in the water? There are 64 rowers today, and every boat holds 4.
follow_up_questions: Every boat must be tied up with 8 metres of rope. How many metres of rope does the club need?

problem: 'Let's put 5 pencils in each bundle,' Ms. Ito says, tipping 23 pencils onto her desk. The classroom clock ticks loudly. How many pencils are left after the full bundles are made?
follow_up_questions: Ms. Ito takes 1 of the leftover pencils for herself. How many leftover pencils are there now?
During art class the pupils use 2 of the full bundles. How many full bundles are still on the desk?
How many pencils are in the remaining bundles and the leftover pile together?

problem: How many sweets are left over once Grandpa Ole fills as many bags of 5 as possible from a jar of 23 sweets? The jar has a shiny red lid.
follow_up_questions: His grandson eats 1 of the leftover sweets. How many leftover sweets remain?
At the picnic, the family eats 2 of the full bags. How many full bags are left?
Altogether, how many sweets are in the remaining bags and the leftover pile?

problem: 'The hot-air balloon carries 6 passengers a flight,' the pilot explains. Bilal reads the list: 43 people have booked. How many flights must the balloon make so everyone flies?
follow_up_questions: Each flight lasts 15 minutes. How many minutes of flying is that in total?

problem: How many sessions will the climbing wall need so that all 43 children on the list get a climb? Only 6 children can climb at a time.
follow_up_questions: One session takes 15 minutes. How many minutes do the sessions take altogether?

problem: At the stables, Rosa lifts a 3-kilogram sack with 40 apples inside. 'Each pony gets 5 apples,' the trainer says. How many ponies can Rosa feed?
follow_up_questions: The stables have 11 ponies. How many ponies get no apples?
The trainer brings 5 apples for each of those ponies. How many apples does she bring?

problem: How many rabbits can Dev feed if every rabbit gets 5 lettuce leaves and his basket holds 40 leaves? The full basket weighs 3 kilograms.
follow_up_questions: The rabbit hutch has 11 rabbits. How many of them go without leaves?
Dev fetches 5 leaves for each hungry rabbit. How many leaves does he fetch?

problem: 'I have 70 tomatoes, and each crate takes 8,' the farmer tells the market crowd. 'The final crate won't be full!' How many tomatoes go into that final crate?
How many beads will be on the last, unfinished bracelet? Jamila is making bracelets with 8 beads each, and she has 70 beads.
'Only 9 riders per wagon,' the farm guide tells a youth club of 30 members. What is the smallest number of wagon rides needed for every member?
follow_up_questions: Each ride needs one adult helper, and the club brought 6 helpers. How many helpers are not on a ride?

problem: A cave tour can take at most 9 visitors. What is the least number of tours needed so that all 30 students from Riverside School can go?
follow_up_questions: Every tour needs one teacher, and 6 teachers came on the trip. How many teachers do not lead a tour?

problem: 'Pack 4 to a box,' the bakery owner tells Pia, passing her a tray with 34 doughnuts. After Pia fills as many boxes as she can, how many doughnuts remain on the tray?
follow_up_questions: A customer buys the leftover doughnuts and 3 of the boxes. How many doughnuts did the customer buy?
How many full boxes remain for other customers?
A box sells for 6 dollars. How much will the bakery earn if it sells all of the remaining boxes?

problem: How many tennis balls will still be in the basket after the coach fills as many tubes of 4 as he can? He starts with 34 balls.
follow_up_questions: A player takes the leftover balls plus 3 full tubes. How many balls does the player take?
How many full tubes are left for the rest of the team?
The club sells each tube for 6 dollars. How much will it earn by selling all of them?

problem: 'There are 61 of us, and the cable car to Station 9 holds only 14,' the ski instructor says. How many cable car trips will it take to get everyone up the mountain?
follow_up_questions: Each trip takes 8 minutes. How long does it take altogether?

problem: How many trips does the ferry to Pier 9 need to carry 61 cyclists if it carries 14 people each time?
follow_up_questions: A trip lasts 8 minutes. How many minutes do all the trips take?

problem: Ana is decorating cards for her grandmother's birthday. She has 27 star stamps and uses 3 on each card. Work out how many cards get stamps.
How many vases can the florist fill if she puts 3 sunflowers in each and has 27 sunflowers?
Coach Bauer is setting out 92 chairs in the gym for the school concert and puts 8 in every row. How many chairs end up in the last row, which is not full?
follow_up_questions: How many full rows of chairs are there?
A balloon is tied to the end of each full row, and balloons come in packs of 5. How many packs of balloons are needed?

problem: How many cupcakes will be in the short row if a baker sets out 92 cupcakes in rows of 8 on her counter?
follow_up_questions: How many rows are full?
She puts a name card on each full row, and the cards come in packs of 5. How many packs of cards does she need?

problem: Jonah and his aunt baked 47 cookies. His aunt says each tin holds 6. How many tins should they get from the cupboard so that no cookie is left out?
follow_up_questions: Jonah carries 2 tins at a time to the car. How many trips does he make?

problem: So that every book has a place, how many boxes does the school library need for 47 old books if each box holds 6?
follow_up_questions: The caretaker carries 2 boxes per trip to the van. How many trips does he make?

problem: Farmer Olu has cut 72 stalks of wheat. 'Tie them in sheaves of 8,' he tells his daughter Ada. How many sheaves will Ada make?
follow_up_questions: The goats eat 3 sheaves each evening. For how many evenings will the sheaves last?
On the final evening the goats also get 5 loose stalks. How many stalks do they eat that evening?

problem: How many bunches can a flower seller make from 72 tulips if she ties 8 tulips into each bunch?
follow_up_questions: She sells 3 bunches every evening at the station. For how many evenings will her bunches last?
On the last evening she also sells 5 single tulips. How many tulips does she sell that evening?

problem: Mia has 30 bibs for the school sports day, which has 6 races. Every team needs 4 bibs. Once she has given full sets to as many teams as possible, how many bibs are left over?
How many crayons remain after a teacher hands out sets of 4 to as many tables as she can? She has 30 crayons, and her classroom has 6 windows.
Uncle Bram is renting tents for a hiking trip with 26 people. Each tent sleeps 3. How many tents does he need so that everyone has a place to sleep?
follow_up_questions: One tent costs 7 dollars to rent. What will the tents cost?

problem: How many golf carts must the club book so that all 26 golfers can ride, if one cart carries 3 golfers?
follow_up_questions: Each cart costs 7 dollars to hire. How much do the carts cost in total?

problem: The farmer's cart carries 6 sacks of grain on each trip to the barn. He has 48 sacks to move. A rooster crows from the fence. How many trips will the farmer make?
follow_up_questions: His son makes 2 of the trips. How many trips does the farmer make himself now?
Each of his trips takes 5 minutes. How many minutes does he spend?
He has 45 minutes before breakfast. How many minutes does he have to spare?

problem: How many trips will the janitor make if she moves 48 chairs and her trolley carries 6 at a time? The school hall smells of fresh paint.
follow_up_questions: A teacher does 2 of the trips for her. How many trips does the janitor make now?
Her trips take 5 minutes each. How many minutes does she spend on them?
Assembly starts in 45 minutes. How many minutes are left over?

problem: 'Every flower bed gets 12 tulip bulbs,' the gardener explains. A bag of 80 bulbs arrives. After each bed that can get a full share is planted, how many bulbs remain in the bag?
follow_up_questions: She plants the extra bulbs in a new bed and adds 3 more from the shed. How many bulbs are in the new bed?
How many bulbs are in all the beds together now?

problem: How many stickers are left after Ms. Park gives 12 stickers to every pupil she can? She has a roll of 80 stickers.
follow_up_questions: She gives the leftover stickers to a new pupil, plus 3 more from her drawer. How many stickers does the new pupil get?
How many stickers have all the pupils received together now?

problem: Each canoe at the lake holds 5 paddlers. 'We have 33 campers today,' Ms. Moreau tells the boat keeper. How many canoes will her campers use?
follow_up_questions: The lake has 12 canoes. How many canoes are free for other people?

problem: How many picnic tables will the 33 guests at Rafael's party fill if every table seats 5 people?
follow_up_questions: The park has 12 tables. How many are left for other families?

problem: The craft club has 88 buttons. 'Each puppet needs 6 buttons, and 15 puppets are waiting,' says the club leader. How many puppets can get a full set of buttons?
How many tables in the hall can get a full set of 6 chairs if there are 88 chairs and 15 tables?
A girl at the fair counts 39 tickets she has won and sorts them into stacks of 5. 'How many tickets won't make a full stack?' her friend asks.
follow_up_questions: Then she wins 2 more tickets and adds them to the small stack. How many tickets are in the small stack now?
How many full stacks of 5 can she make now?

problem: How many conkers are left over that don't make a full row? Sam lines up 39 conkers in rows of 5 on the windowsill.
follow_up_questions: His sister hands him 2 more, and he puts them with the leftover conkers. How many leftover conkers are there now?
How many full rows of 5 can Sam count now?

problem: A choir of 50 singers is filling the cinema. 'Each row here has 6 seats,' the usher says. Counting a row that is only partly full, how many rows will the choir use?
follow_up_questions: The cinema has 32 rows. How many rows are left for other moviegoers?

problem: How many rows of the stadium will 50 fans take up if each row has 6 seats, counting a row that is not completely full?
follow_up_questions: That section has 32 rows. How many rows are free for other fans?

problem: 'Groups of 3 look nicest,' Noa says, holding 24 paper flowers for the class party. Rain taps on the window. How many groups can she make?
follow_up_questions: She puts 2 groups on the door. How many groups are left for inside?
Inside, she puts the same number of groups on each of 3 tables. How many groups go on each table?
How many paper flowers are on each table?

problem: How many bundles of 3 can Grandad tie if he has 24 carrots from the garden? A robin is watching him from the fence.
follow_up_questions: He gives 2 bundles to his neighbour. How many bundles does he have left?
He shares those bundles evenly among 3 baskets. How many bundles go in each basket?
How many carrots are in each basket?

problem: Ella and Kwame baked 40 muffins in 3 ovens. 'A tin holds 9 muffins,' Kwame says. 'How many tins do we need for all of them?'
follow_up_questions: Each tin costs 2 dollars. How much do they spend on tins?
On the way to the bake sale they eat 4 of the muffins. How many muffins are left?

problem: How many boxes do Ingrid and Tomás need for the 40 potatoes they dug from 3 garden beds, if one box holds 9 potatoes?
follow_up_questions: Borrowing a box costs 2 dollars. What do they pay?
They cook 4 of the potatoes for dinner. How many potatoes are left?

problem: The school kitchen has 90 grapes for snack time. 'Five for each child, no more,' the cook says. How many children can get their grapes?
How many guests can get stickers if the host has 90 stickers and gives exactly 5 to each guest?
The stable hand has 45 carrots. 'Each horse eats 9 carrots at lunch,' she says. For how many horses is that enough?
follow_up_questions: The stable has 7 horses. How many horses still need carrots?
How many more carrots does the stable hand need for them?
She finds 10 extra carrots in the fridge. How many does she still need to buy?

problem: How many pigs can Farmer Lu feed with 45 scoops of grain if each pig eats 9 scoops?
follow_up_questions: There are 7 pigs on the farm. How many pigs are still waiting for grain?
How many more scoops of grain are needed for them?
He finds 10 scoops left in an old sack. How many more scoops must he buy?

problem: 'Our family has 18 people coming to dinner,' Mrs. Gupta tells the restaurant. Each table there seats 4. How many tables should the restaurant set?
How many cars are needed to drive 18 dancers to the show if each car can take 4 of them?
Priya's school orchestra has 55 musicians going to a concert, and each van holds 11. How many vans will the orchestra fill?
follow_up_questions: The school only gets 3 vans. How many musicians are left without a seat?
Teachers' cars can take 4 musicians each. How many cars are needed for them?

problem: How many dragon boats will the rowing club fill if each boat holds 11 and 55 members are going to the race?
follow_up_questions: Only 3 dragon boats are free. How many members have no boat?
Small rowing boats can take 4 members each. How many small boats are needed for them?

problem: A florist gets 38 roses and wraps them in bunches of 5 for her shop. 'One bunch will be short,' she notices. How many roses go in that bunch?
follow_up_questions: She sells those roses for 2 dollars each. How much does she earn from them?

problem: How many apples are in the bag that isn't full, if a farmer packs 38 apples into bags of 5?
follow_up_questions: She sells each of those apples for 2 dollars. How much money does she get for them?

problem: 'The truck brought 75 crates of melons, and my forklift lifts 8 at a time,' the warehouse worker tells her trainee. To move all the crates, how many lifts will it take?
follow_up_questions: Her trainee does 3 of the lifts. How many lifts does the worker do herself?
Each of her lifts takes 6 minutes. How long does she spend lifting?

problem: How many loads must the laundry trolley make to carry 75 towels if it holds 8 towels per load?
follow_up_questions: A housekeeper takes 3 of the loads. How many loads are left for the laundry worker?
Each of those loads takes 6 minutes. How many minutes does the laundry worker spend?

problem: Leo's little brother is 9 today. Their mum bakes 32 mini muffins and says, 'Each guest gets 4.' How many guests can have muffins?
How many children can share 32 strawberries if each child gets 4? There are 9 balloons tied to the garden gate.
Amelia is putting 98 photographs into an album with 12 on each page. When every full page is done, how many photographs are left over?
follow_up_questions: She gives the spare photographs to her cousin, who already has 15. How many photographs does her cousin have now?

problem: How many marbles are left after a boy fills as many bags of 12 as he can from his 98 marbles?
follow_up_questions: He gives the leftover marbles to his friend, who already owns 15. How many marbles does his friend own now?

problem: 'My boat only takes 7 crates per trip,' the fisherman Tavita sighs. His crew has filled 25 crates of fish. Gulls scream above the harbour. How many trips must he make to the market?
follow_up_questions: Each trip to the market takes 9 minutes. How long does he spend sailing?
Each crate of fish sells for 4 dollars. How much will all the crates bring in?
Tavita pays his crew 35 dollars. How much money does he keep?

problem: How many trips must the van make to carry 25 boxes of books to the school fair if it takes 7 boxes per trip? The van is painted bright green.
follow_up_questions: One trip takes 9 minutes. How many minutes are spent driving?
Each box of books sells for 4 dollars at the fair. How much money do all the boxes bring in?
The school pays 35 dollars for the van. How much money is left?

problem: 'The cupboard has 84 juice boxes,' the coach tells Lila, 'and they come 12 to a carton.' Find the number of cartons in the cupboard.
follow_up_questions: The team drinks 2 cartons at each match. For how many full matches will the cartons last?
How many cartons are left over after those matches?

problem: How many packets are there if a shop has 84 pencils and sells them 12 to a packet?
follow_up_questions: A school buys 2 packets at each visit. For how many full visits will the packets last?
How many packets are left after those visits?

problem: Grandma is putting 6 candles on each of the cakes for a family party, and she has 35 candles. After she has decorated as many cakes as she can, how many candles are left?
follow_up_questions: Then 3 more cakes arrive. How many candles would it take to give each of them a full set?

problem: How many stamps are left over? A post office worker sticks 6 stamps on each parcel and has a sheet of 35 stamps, finishing as many parcels as she can.
follow_up_questions: Later, 3 more parcels come in. How many stamps does she need to give each of them a full set?

problem: The skating coach can teach no more than 9 children in one lesson. Today 48 children have signed up at the rink, which opened 21 years ago. How many lessons must she give?
How many lessons will the riding school need for 48 riders if at most 9 riders can be in a lesson? The stable has 21 horses.
The observatory guide lets pupils look through the big telescope in groups of 5. If 35 pupils are visiting, how many groups will there be?
follow_up_questions: Each group gets 2 minutes at the telescope. How long do all the groups take?
Clouds will cover the sky in 20 minutes. How many minutes remain after the last group?

problem: How many groups of 5 can be made from 35 children who want to pet the baby lambs at the farm?
follow_up_questions: Each group spends 2 minutes in the pen. How many minutes do all the groups spend there?
The lambs get fed in 20 minutes. How many minutes are left after the last group finishes?

problem: The school secretary tells Owen that every class gets a pile of 15 worksheets. He has 98 worksheets. Once the full piles are made, how many worksheets are left over?
follow_up_questions: How many more worksheets would make one more full pile?

problem: How many leaflets are left over when 98 leaflets are bundled 15 to a bundle for the town's market stalls?
follow_up_questions: How many more leaflets would be needed to make one more full bundle?

problem: The art teacher's trolley holds only 8 sketchbooks. Thirty pupils are waiting, and each needs a sketchbook. The art room has big windows. How many trolley trips will she make?
follow_up_questions: Each pupil also gets 6 coloured pencils. How many pencils is that in all?
At the end of class, 45 pencils are broken. How many are not broken?
She stores the unbroken pencils in boxes, 9 to a box. How many boxes does she fill?

problem: How many trips must the library helper make with a cart that carries 8 puzzles, if 30 children each need a puzzle? Snow is falling outside the library.
follow_up_questions: Each puzzle comes with 6 stickers. How many stickers come with all the children's puzzles?
By the end of the day, 45 stickers have been lost. How many stickers are left?
The helper puts the remaining stickers on sheets, 9 to a sheet. How many sheets does she fill?

problem: The tram line that Ms. Okoye drives is 8 kilometres long. By evening she has driven 96 kilometres. How many times did she drive the whole line?
follow_up_questions: After each trip along the line she rests for 5 minutes. How many minutes of rest did she have?

problem: How many times did Pablo ride round the bike loop if the loop is 8 kilometres and he rode 96 kilometres this week?
follow_up_questions: He stops for a 5-minute rest after each loop. How many minutes did he rest in all?

problem: A sticker machine at the mall says, 'One sticker costs 5 tokens.' Lina has 29 tokens and 2 hair clips in her pocket. If she buys as many stickers as she can, how many tokens will she have left?
follow_up_questions: Her brother gives her 6 more tokens. How many tokens does Lina have now?
How many more stickers can she buy with these tokens?

problem: How many marbles will Felix have left after buying as many toy cars as he can? Each car costs 5 marbles at the playground swap, he has 29 marbles, and he owns 2 yo-yos.
follow_up_questions: A friend gives him 6 more marbles. How many marbles does Felix have now?
How many more toy cars can he get with those marbles?

problem: After the concert, 45 fans need a lift to the train station. The festival shuttle seats 7, and it keeps driving back and forth until all of them have gone. How many trips will the shuttle make?
How many trips will the minibus make if it seats 7 and must take 45 hikers back to the village, returning until everyone is there?
Mrs. Ndlovu has a bag of 18 party hats. 'Can every guest have 2 hats?' her son Sipho asks. How many guests can get two hats each?
follow_up_questions: Sipho invited 11 guests. How many of them will not get hats?

problem: How many children can each get 2 apples if the teacher has a basket of 18 apples?
follow_up_questions: There are 11 children in the reading group. How many of them will go without apples?

problem: The school bake club is boxing 75 cupcakes, 8 to a box. The kitchen smells of vanilla. Once every box that can be full is full, how many cupcakes are left over?
follow_up_questions: The club sells each full box for 6 dollars. How much money is that?
